title: Selecting the Right Fitting: Sanitary Tee vs Combo Wye
description: Understanding proper fitting selection is critical for maintaining correct flow dynamics in a drainage system. A sanitary tee is designed specifically for transitioning from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. Using a sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal pipe transition creates severe flow turbulence and increases the risk of waste buildup and backups. For horizontal drainage direction changes or horizontal branch connections, professionals always install a wye with a 1/8 bend or a combination wye fitting to ensure a smooth, low-resistance waste transition.
